lead: Twinkle Khanna is an Indian film actor, born on 29 December 1974 in Pune.
As of 2026, she is 51 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.
She has 22 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.
This profile collects the Twinkle facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Twinkle Khanna — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Twinkle Khanna was born on 29 December 1974 in Pune, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Rajesh Khanna and her mother, Dimple Kapadia. She is a sibling of Rinke Khanna.
She received her education at Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
